limitations: Warm profiling is four brief single-player samples, not a complete campaign or co-op endurance test.
Stage 8 had one 74.9ms frame; Stage 5 averaged 54.1FPS in the sampled window.
The new password arsenal selectors and recovery are tested; a full song-length playthrough of every new attack interleaving is still a manual acceptance check.
Directional front-plate shields keep their existing aiming rule; field/bubble shields now scale to both hull dimensions.
